end.summary:
Discussed Unity in Diversity through Pongal, Lohri and Makar Sankranti.
Connected shared harvest-season ideas with different regional celebrations.
Identified phiran as clothing, not a festival, in an odd-one-out example.
Language-diversity recall was practised; the number 22 was repeated after initial uncertainty.
Teach-back was not completed successfully.
end.parentNote: Riya practised comparing festivals by looking at both the shared idea and regional differences, such as foods, activities and clothing. They also used the odd-one-out method to identify phiran as dress rather than a festival. They were initially unsure about the number 22 but corrected it later in the lesson (correctAfterLastSeen: true). At home, ask them to make a four-part chart with one example each for language, food, dress and festivals across Indian regions.
